lines.trans: Hello! I arrived for an appointment.
Good day! Are you here to see Dmitry Vladimirovich?
Yes, he invited me for a job.
The owner is busy in the kitchen for now.
Understood. And who is managing the dining room?
That strict young woman over by the window.
What is this beautiful young woman's name?
This is Viktoria Sergeyevna, our art director.
Oh no, what an unpleasant situation!
What happened? You turned so pale!
Nothing terrible, my head is spinning.
Would you like to sit at an available table?
No, thank you, I will step back.

examples.trans: Vika works as the restaurant art director.

meanings.note: pointing at something a little way off
вон отсюда! = get out of here!
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)
'голову оторвать' = to tear someone's head off
meanings.note: an idiom for a big telling-off

examples.trans: Mum will tear my head off.

examples.text: Девушки, как я, у тебя не будет!
examples.trans: You'll never have a girl like me!

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер
of a person: я занят = I'm busy
of a place: здесь занято = it's occupied
звать на помощь = to call for help
как тебя зовут? = what's your name? меня зовут ... = my name is ...
polite, or to several people; the first в is silent

examples.trans: There's someone here to see you.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know
in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.trans: They have a very beautiful house.

meanings.note: голова кружится = one's head is spinning, one feels dizzy

examples.trans: The leaves are whirling in the wind.
Three rooms and a big kitchen.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: два года назад = two years ago

examples.text: Я их ещё два года назад им выделил!
examples.trans: I allocated it to them two years ago!

examples.text: У нас возникла неприятная ситуация на работе.
examples.trans: An unpleasant situation arose at our work.

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.trans: He is looking out the window.

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

отойти.gloss: to step back, to move away

meanings.en: to step aside, to move back

examples.trans: He stepped over to the window.

examples.text: Он сильно побледнел от неожиданной новости.
examples.trans: He turned very pale from the unexpected news.

meanings.note: as a conjunction: пока я сплю

examples.trans: Security will be here any moment.

руководить.gloss: to lead, to head, to manage

meanings.en: to lead, to head, to direct

meanings.note: свободен! = you're dismissed (a boss to an employee)

meanings.en: to sit down, to take a seat

examples.trans: He sat down on a chair.
This is a very complicated situation.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

meanings.en: to hide oneself, to take cover

examples.text: Вы вообще в свою комнату спрятались!
examples.trans: You hid in your own room altogether!
The cat hid under the bed.

meanings.en: urgently, right away; predicative: it is urgent

examples.trans: I need to make a phone call urgently.

examples.text: Они заняли свободный столик у окна.
examples.trans: They took a free table near the window.
How strict you are, Klavdia Viktorovna.

examples.text: У нас в школе очень строгий директор.
examples.trans: We have a very strict principal at our school.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
The restaurant owner personally greets the guests.
If you don't want to, suit yourself.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
